combos.name: GLACIAL DESTRUCTION
combos.description: ICE NO ESCAPE COMBO is a powerful freeze combo that chains ICE V2, Gravity Cane, Cyborg, and Godhuman for constant pressure and devastating damage.
combos.sequence: GRAVITY CANE Z -> ICE V2 V -> ICE V1 C -> ICE V2 Z -> CYBORG V3 -> GODHUMAN X -> GODHUMAN Z -> GODHUMAN C -> GRAVITY CANE X -> ICE V2 X

combos.name: GAS DOMINATION
combos.description: GAS OP COMBO is a relentless combo that chains Gas, Cursed Dual Katana, Cyborg, and Godhuman for massive damage and nonstop pressure.
combos.sequence: GODHUMAN C -> CYBORG V3 -> GAS Z -> GAS X -> GAS C -> CURSED DUAL KATANA Z (HOLD FOR MAX DAMAGE) -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> TURN AROUND -> GODHUMAN Z -> GODHUMAN X -> REPEAT

combos.name: DOUGH WRATH
combos.description: DOUGH BASIC COMBO is a deadly combo that chains Dough V2, Cursed Dual Katana, Cyborg, and Godhuman for huge damage and relentless pressure
combos.sequence: GODHUMAN C -> DOUGH V2 X (WHILE ON AIR) -> DOUGH V2 C -> CYBORG V3 -> GODHUMAN Z -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> CURSED DUAL KATANA Z -> DOUGH V2 V -> GODHUMAN X -> LOOK SLIGHTLY UP -> GODHUMAN C -> REPEAT

combos.name: REX APOCALYPSE
combos.description: TREX COMBO is a powerful combo that chains T-Rex, Cursed Dual Katana, Cyborg, and Godhuman for heavy damage and strong pressure.
combos.sequence: GODHUMAN C -> CYBORG V3 -> TREX C -> TREX X (HOLD FOR MAX DAMAGE) -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> TURN AROUND -> GODHUMAN Z -> GODHUMAN X -> LOOK SLIGHTLY UP -> TREX Z -> GODHUMAN C -> REPEAT

combos.name: KING'S COMBO
combos.description: KING'S COMBO is a devastating combo that chains Flame V2, Cursed Dual Katana, Ghoul, and Electric Claw for massive damage and relentless pressure.
combos.sequence: ELECTRIC CLAW C -> FLAME V2 C -> CURSED DUAL KATANA Z -> KABUCHA X -> FLAME V2 V -> FLAME V2 Z -> FLAME V2 X -> ELECTRIC CLAW X -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> TURN AROUND -> ELECTRIC CLAW Z

combos.name: PORTAL MAYHEM
combos.description: PORTAL META ONE-TAP is a top-tier PvP meta combo featuring Portal and Soul Guitar to trap opponents and deliver unavoidable burst damage.
combos.sequence: PORTAL X -> SOUL GUITAR Z -> GODHUMAN C -> CURSED DUAL KATANA Z -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> GODHUMAN Z -> GODHUMAN X

combos.name: VOLTAGE CHAOS
combos.description: SANGUINE RUMBLE ONE-SHOT abuses Rumble V2's heavy stuns and Sanguine Art's lifesteal to completely lock down meta players.
combos.sequence: Lightning F -> Lightning X -> Lightning C -> SOUL GUITAR Z -> SANGUINE ART C -> GRAVITY BLADE Z -> SANGUINE ART Z -> SANGUINE ART X

combos.name: DARK REQUIEM
combos.description: DARK BLOOD COMBO is a deadly combo that combines Dark, Sanguine Art, Cursed Dual Katana, Kabucha, and Ghoul for heavy damage and relentless pressure.
combos.sequence: DARK V2 C -> SANGUINE ART C -> SANGUINE ART Z -> CURSED DUAL KATANA X -> CURSED DUAL KATANA Z (HOLD) -> SANGUINE ART X

combos.name: EARTHBREAKER
combos.description: Trap your enemy, break their defenses, and unleash a cataclysm of earthquakes and venom. A brutal combo with no escape.
combos.sequence: QUAKE V2 V -> SPIKEY TRIDENT X -> VENOM BOW X -> GOD HUMAN X -> GOD HUMAN Z -> GOD HUMAN C -> QUAKE V2 Z

combos.name: SPIDER EXECUTION
combos.description: A deadly combo that traps the enemy with Spider, overwhelms them with Death Step, poisons them with Venom, and uses Spikey Trident to control and keep them trapped in the combo.
combos.sequence: SPIDER V2 X -> SPIDER V2 Z -> SPIDER V2 V -> SPIKEY TRIDENT X -> VENOM BOW X -> DEATH STEP C -> DEATH STEP Z -> DEATH STEP X -> SPIDER V2 C

combos.name: KITSUNE RAMPAGE
combos.description: A fast and unpredictable combo combining Kitsune’s mobility, Yama’s control, Soul Guitar’s pressure, and God Human’s power.
combos.sequence: GOD HUMAN C -> KITSUNE F -> YAMA X -> KITSUNE X -> KITSUNE V -> GOD HUMAN X -> GOD HUMAN Z

combos.name: PAIN DEVASTATION
combos.description: A fast and devastating combo combining the power of God Human, the control of Yama, and the unpredictable attacks of Pain.
combos.sequence: GOD HUMAN C -> PAIN X -> YAMA X -> PAIN V -> PAIN C -> GOD HUMAN X -> GOD HUMAN Z
